Jwt.//SigningKey: LOCAL DEVELOPMENT KEY ONLY. Production must supply Jwt:SigningKey via user-secrets, an environment variable (Jwt__SigningKey), or a key vault — never a committed file.
Jwt.//BypassForLocalTesting: Set true to auto-authenticate every request via X-Dev-Sub/X-Dev-Role headers instead of a real token. Development-only, and it makes real login tokens irrelevant.
